summary: The Resource Ledger, as agreed by all six reviewers. 8 std::thread: owner the local workers vector, acquired at emplace_back after reserve, released by the ScopeExit joiner (and the explicit join loop) on every exit, no transfer, no detach. 8 stack httplib::Server objects, one per worker: no fd and no thread (the task queue is built lazily in listen), the constructor's only side effect is the idempotent signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN) (non-Windows). Registry and inventory entries: owned by the per-worker Clean guard, which forgets at construction and destruction, plus an explicit forget each round. Captures by reference: one atomic<bool> gate and one atomic<int> failure counter, both outliving the joins, and the joiner lambda, which holds references to the workers vector and the gate and is destroyed before both (declaration order). No fd, socket, FILE*, SQLite, OpenSSL object, temp path or subprocess.
